Usage: mai [options] [command]

LinkedIn autonomous agent

Options:
  -V, --version        output the version number
  --model <spec>       LLM model spec (provider:modelId); overrides MAI_MODEL
  --prompt <text>      one-shot prompt; exits after response
  --new-session        start a fresh session (discard prior context) (default:
                       false)
  --cwd <dir>          working directory for session storage (default:
                       "/Users/kyoubelyu/Kyoube-Skills/mai-agent")
  --reset-identity     delete identity.json and re-run first-run bootstrap
                       (default: false)
  --max-steps <n>      max agent-loop tool-call steps per turn (overrides
                       MAI_MAX_STEPS; default 200)
  -h, --help           display help for command

Commands:
  soul <action>        Soul-band controls: 'show' prints composed Soul; 'edit'
                       opens identity.json in $EDITOR; 'reset' re-prompts the 4
                       free axes.
  auth                 Provider key management (~/.mai/auth.json)
  identity             Operator identity management
  sessions             Session management
  version
  telegram             Bidirectional Telegram channel management
  server               Operator's orchestrator agent
  gh                   GitHub issue tool configuration
  search               Web search API key management
  serve [options]      HTTP-over-UDS bridge for the v0.5 Tauri desktop shell
  update [options]     Check for mai-agent updates on GitHub Releases
  uninstall [options]  Remove the global mai install (bin + package symlink +
                       release dirs); --purge also removes ~/.mai/
  status               Show agent status (auth + chrome + identity + telegram +
                       cron + memory)
  cron                 Cron schedule management
  setup                Interactive wizard: auth + identity + telegram + soul
                       configuration
